Field: Milestone Identifier and Baseline Target Date
Guidance: Milestone code, deliverable name, and original approved baseline completion date.
Bi-weekly or monthly sequential forecasts tracking milestone date movements over time.

Field: Current Variance and Slip Days Calculated
Guidance: Net difference in working days between current forecast and baseline date.

Field: Root Cause of Schedule Drift and Dependencies
Guidance: Underlying drivers (supplier delay, scope change, technical hurdles) causing milestone slippage.

Field: Schedule Recovery Actions and Target Stabilization
Guidance: Crashing, fast-tracking, or resource reallocations committed to recover milestone timing.
